notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign is LIVE
notes.content:
[b]The Day is Upon us![/b]

Making this game has been such a long and winding path, but we are so proud of what has been accomplished.  After eating frozen burritos and ramen for a couple years, we’re seeking some proper funding through Kickstarter!

BACK US NOW: [url=bit.ly/swordcery]bit.ly/swordcery[/url]

All contributions will go towards improving the game!  We’ve got a decent base game going, but we’re looking to make this bad boi special.  We want more swords, tighter combat, better item synergy, better visuals, etc… The list is intimidating, but we’re hoping this campaign will make it less scary!

Seeing all the outpour of support and suggestions has motivated us through these long months of preparation.  Even if you don’t contribute to the campaign, you can help us by getting the word out!  Word of mouth is POWERFUL so tell your friends and family about our Kickstarter! 

We can’t wait to make the best game we can with you all.  From the bottom of our hilts, thank you all.

-Don and Mike

notes.title: Swordcery: Prologue v1.0.2 Updates
notes.content:
[u]Swordcery: Prologue v1.0.2 Updates 10/21/21[/u]
-Buffing Aim Assist radius on melee attacks so less whiffing occurs
-Reducing range of adaptive camera to keep the camera more steady and focused on player. This should also reduce the problems with trees obstructing view a bit
-Removed a random cube that was on the start screen, what the heck?

notes.title: Swordcery: Prologue v1.0.1 Updates
notes.content:
[u]Swordcery: Prologue v1.0.1 Updates 10/10/21[/u]
-Boss transitions no longer get stuck from regular attacks
-Boss will continue shockwave attack endlessly regardless of player position

notes.title: SWORDCERY: PROLOGUE IS HERE + WE'RE COMING TO KICKSTARTER
notes.content:
[b]Swordcery: Prologue is finally finished and ready for you all to try! [/b]

The full game is still a work in progress, but we hope that the prologue will allow you to see a bit of our vision come to life. We'll be working hard to add more content and refinement for the final game, but in the meantime, we hope you enjoy this bite-sized experience of the first level.

[b]If you'd like to discuss the demo or report any bugs you find please join us on Discord: [/b][url=discord.gg/YNMYDr7]discord.gg/YNMYDr7[/url]

[b]If you enjoy the prologue and want to help support us, please sign up for our Kickstarter: [/b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/templedoorgames/swordcery-an-action-packed-sword-swingin-rogue-like]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/templedoorgames/swordcery-an-action-packed-sword-swingin-rogue-like[/url]

It's coming soon and we'll have early bird backer tiers! So you won't wanna miss out on day 1 of the campaign ːsteamhappyː
